Source: Japan, the USA, Chile and Peru produce most of the world’s fish oil, but developing countries like Kenya turn masses of its fish biowaste (biological fish material left over after the flesh is removed, such as the organs) into this valuable product for the global market.
Luganda: Japan, USA, Chile ne Peru zikola butto asinga mu nsi yonna akolebwa mu byennyanja, naye amawanga agakyakula gamba nga Kenya gaddira ebisigalira by’ebyennyanja (ebintu ebisigalawo ku kyennyanja ng’emiwula giggyiddwako, gamba ng’ebitundu by’omunda) ne gakolamu ekyamaguzi eky’omuwendo ne kigenda ku katale k’ensi yonna.
Yoruba: Àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè bí i Japan, USA, Chile àti Peru ni wọ́n máa ń ṣẹ̀dá ọ̀pọ̀ nínú àwọn epo ẹja ní agbáyé, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tó ń ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ń dàgbàsókè bí i Kenya máa ń sọ ìdọ̀tí-ohun ẹlẹ́mìí inú ẹja (Àwọn nǹkan èlò tó kù lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n yọ ẹran ara ẹja kúrò, bí i àwọn ìfun) di ọjà oníye ní ọjà lágbàáyé.
Zulu: I-Japan, i-USA, i-Chile kanye ne-Peru ikhiqiza amafutha amaningi ezinhlanzi emhlabeni, kodwa amazwe asathuthuka njengeKenya aguqula inqwaba yodoti obunayo wezinhlanzi zayo (izinto zezinhlanzi eziphilayo ezisala ngemva kokukhishwa kwenyama, njengezitho) zibe lo mkhiqizo obalulekile.
Hausa: Japan da Amurka da Chile da kuma Peru suna samar da mafi yawan man kifi na duniya, amma ƙasashe masu tasowa kamar Kenya suna juya yawancin dattin halittar kifi (kayan kifin da ya rage bayan an cire naman, kamar gaɓoɓin) cikin wannan samfurin mai mahimmanci don kasuwar duniya.
Northern Sotho: Japan, USA, Chile le Peru di tšweletša bontši bja makhura a hlapi mo lefaseng, eupša dinaga tše di hlabologago tša go swana le Kenya di fetoša bontši bja dilahlwa tša hlapi (mašaledi a go tšwa hlaping ka morago ga ge nama ya hlapi e tlošitšwe, tša go swana le ditho tša ka teng) go ba setšweletšwa se bohlokwa se sa go tla go šomišwa ke mmarata wa lefase ka bophara.

Source: They wanted to adapt an existing “wet processing extraction” technique that involves heating it to release the oil from the tissues, and then washing the oil to remove other impurities.

Source: They extracted the oil from fish guts at high temperatures - they used 80, 90, 95 or 97 degrees celsius.

Hausa: Sun auna adadin man kifi da suka iya matsowa a yanayi daban-daban, da kuma matakan Omega-3 acid na kitse da bitamin, waɗanda suke nuna ingancin.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba ela tekano ya makhura a hlapi ao ba ilego ba kgona go a ntšha ka dithempheretšha tše di fapanego, gammogo le maemo a difethiesithi tša Omega-3 le a dibithamene, e lego seo se laetšago boleng.
Amharic: በተለያየ የሙቀት መጠን ማውጣት የቻሉትን የዓሳ ዘይት መጠን እንዲሁም ጥራቱን በሚጠቁም ሁኔታ የኦሜጋ-3 ቅባታማ አሲዶች እና የቫይታሚን መጠንን ለክተዋል።

Source: They were able to extract the most fish oil by heating the fish biowaste to 80 degrees celsius for 30 minutes.
Luganda: Baasobola okufuna butto w’ebyennyanja asinga obungi nga bafumba ebisigalira by’ebyennyanja ku bbugumu lya ddiguli 80 eza celsius okumala eddakiika 30.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí ọpọ epo ẹja gbà nípa kíko iná mọ́ ìdọ̀tí- ohun elémìí tí inú ẹja pẹ̀lú sẹ́nsọ́sì dìgírìn fún ọgbọ̀n ìṣẹ́jú.
Zulu: Bakwazi ukukhipha amafutha amaningi enhlanzi ngokushisisa i-biowaste yezinhlanzi ibe ngu-80 degrees celsius imizuzu engu-30.
Hausa: Sun sami damar fitar da mafi yawan man kifi ta hanyar ɗumama dattin halittar kifin zuwa digiri 80 na celsius na mintuna 30.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba kgona go ntšha makhura a mantši a hlapi ka go fiša dilahlwa tša hlapi ka dikgata tša selšiase tše 80 mo metsotsong ye 30.
Amharic: ለ30 ደቂቃዎች የዓሳውን ባዮ ቆሻሻ በ80 ዲግሪ ሴንቲ ግሬድ በማሞቅ ከፍተኛውን የዓሣ ዘይት ማውጣት ችለዋል።

Source: The best quality oil was achieved when they washed with water warmed to 95 degrees celsius.
Luganda: Butto asinga omutindo yafunibwa nga boozezza n’amazzi agaafumbibwa ne gatuuka ku ddiguli 95 eza celsius.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí èpo ẹja tó dára nígbà tí wọ́n fọ̀ ó pẹ̀lú omi tí lílọ́ rẹ̀ to dìgírì sẹ́nsọ́sì 95.
Zulu: Amafutha aseqophelelweni eliphezulu kakhulu atholakala lapho ewashwa ngamanzi afudumele afinyelela ku-95 degrees celsius.
Hausa: An samu mafi kyawun mai lokacin da aka wanke su da ruwan ɗumi zuwa digiri 95 na celsius.
Northern Sotho: Makhura a boleng bjo bokaone a hweditšwe ge ba hlatswa ka meetse ao a ruthufaditšwego ka dikgrata tša diselšiase tše 95.
Amharic: በጣም ጥሩ ጥራት ያለው ዘይት በተሳካ ሁኔታ የተገኘው በ95 ዲግሪ ሴንቲ ግሬድ በሞቀ ውሃ ሲያጥቡት ነው።

Source: Given that developing countries like Kenya do not produce much of their own fish oils, the process described here could help boost the industry.
Luganda: Engeri gye kiri nti amawanga agakyakula gamba nga Kenya tegakola butto waago akolebwa mu byennyanja, enkola eno ennyonnyoddwa wano esobola okuyambako mu kutumbula amakolero agakikolako.
Yoruba: Níwọ̀n ìgbà tí ó jẹ́ pé orilẹ-èdè tó ń dàgbàsókè bí i Kenya kì í ṣẹ̀dá epo ẹja tó pọ̀ lọ́ dọ̀ wọ́n, ìlànà tí a ṣe àpèjúwe rẹ̀ yóò ràn ilé-iṣẹ́ náà lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Uma kubhekwa ukuthi amazwe asathuthuka njengeKenya awakhiqizi amafutha amaningi ezinhlanzi awo, inqubo echazwe lapha ingasiza ekufukuleni imboni.
Hausa: Ganin cewa kƙsashe masu tasowa irin su Kenya ba sa samar da man kifi da yawa, tsarin da aka bayyana a nan zai taimaka wajen bunƙasa masana'antar.
Northern Sotho: Ka lebaka la gore dinaga tša go swana le Kenya ga di tšweletše bontši bja makhura a tšona a dihlapi, tshepedišo ye e hlalošitšwego mo e ka thuša go thekga intasteri ye.
Amharic: እንደ ኬኒያ ያሉ ታዳጊ ሃገራት ብዙ የራሳቸውን የዓሳ ዘይት እንደማያመርቱ ታሳቢ በማድረግ እዚህ የተገለጸው ሂደት ኢንዱስትሪውን ለማሳደግ ሊረዳ ይችላል።

Source: The Kenyan researchers hope their method will ultimately help to create jobs, local fish oil products, and less fish biowaste.
Luganda: Abanooyereza okuva mu ggwanga lya Kenya basuubira nti enkola yaabwe ku nkomerero ejja kuyambako mu kutondawo emirimu, ebintu ebikolebwa mu butto akamulwa mu byennyanja awamu n’okuba ng’ebisigalira by’ebyennyanja bisagadde bitono.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣẹ̀wádìí ní èrò pé ọ̀nà tí àwọn gbé̀kalè máá pèsè ìṣẹ́, síṣe epo ẹja ní agbègbè, àti ìdínkù nínú ìdọ̀tí-ohun elémìí tó wà nínú ẹja.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baseKenya bathemba ukuthi indlela yabo ekugcineni izosiza ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi, imikhiqizo yasendaweni kawoyela wezinhlanzi, kanye nodoti wezinhlanzi obunayo omncane.
Hausa: Masu binciken na Kenya suna fatan hanyarsu a ƙarshe za ta taimaka wajen samar da ayyukan yi, da albarkatun man kifi na gida, da ƙarancin dattin halittar kifi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ka Kenya ba holofela gore mokgwa wa bona mafelelong o ka thuša go hloma mešomo, ditšwleetša tša makhura a hlapi tša ka nageng, le dihlahlwa tša hlapi tše nnyane.
Amharic: የኬኒያ ተመራማሪዎች በመጨረሻ ስልታቸው የስራ እድልን ለመፍጠር፣ የሃገር ውስጥ የዓሳ ዘይት ምርቶችን እና አነስተኛ የዓሳ ባዮ ቆሻሻዎችን ለማምረት እንደሚረዳ ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።
